 Weather update: Forecast for southern cities on 27 October
 Amaravati is expected to experience generally cloudy skies, with few spells of rain or thundershowers. 
 South First Desk Published Oct 27, 2026 | 7:00 AM ⚊ Updated Oct 27, 2026 | 7:00 AM 
 Share
 Hyderabad is expected to experience partly cloudy skies with the possibility of rain, a thunderstorm or a duststorm.
 -->
 Make Us Your Preferred Source on Google 
 Planning your day in the South Indian cities of Amaravati, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, or Thiruvananthapuram? Here’s what the weather has in store.
 Cloudy skies and rain are expected across several southern cities on Tuesday, according to the India Meteorological Department’s forecast. 
 Amaravati: Thunderstorm 
 Amaravati is expected to experience generally cloudy skies, with few spells of rain or thundershowers. 
 The temperature is expected to range between a low of 29°C and a high of 34°C.
 A warning has been issued for thunderstorm accompanied with lightning and strong surface winds.
 Bengaluru: Cloudy sky 
 Bengaluru is expected to experience partly cloudy sky.
 The temperature is expected to range between a low of 20°C and a high of 28°C.
 No warning has been issued.
 Chennai: Cloudy sky 
 Chennai is expected to experience partly cloudy sky.
 The temperature is expected to range between a low of 25°C and a high of 32°C.
 No warning has been issued.
 Hyderabad: Haze 
 Hyderabad is expected to experience partly cloudy sky with haze.
 The temperature is expected to range between a low of 21°C and a high of 32°C.
 No warning has been issued.
 Thiruvananthapuram: Thundershowers 
 Thiruvananthapuram is expected to experience generally cloudy skies with one or two spells of rain or Thundershowers.
 The temperature is expected to range between a low of 24°C and a high of 32°C.
 No warning has been issued.
